IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.external_file_formats WHERE name = 'SynapseParquetFormat') 
	CREATE EXTERNAL FILE FORMAT [SynapseParquetFormat] 
	WITH ( FORMAT_TYPE = PARQUET)
GO

IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM sys.external_data_sources WHERE name = 'cbc360functest_cbcd360devstoacct01sg_dfs_core_windows_net') 
	CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE [cbc360functest_cbcd360devstoacct01sg_dfs_core_windows_net] 
	WITH (
		LOCATION = 'abfss://cbc360functest@cbcd360devstoacct01sg.dfs.core.windows.net' 
	)
GO

CREATE EXTERNAL TABLE dbo.new_ext_customer (
	[empid] nvarchar(4000),
	[empname] nvarchar(4000),
	[gender] nvarchar(4000),
	[country] nvarchar(4000),
	[remarks] nvarchar(4000)
	)
	WITH (
	LOCATION = 'Parquet/CBC_CCD_DimCustomer_1_20220526.parquet',
	DATA_SOURCE = [cbc360functest_cbcd360devstoacct01sg_dfs_core_windows_net],
	FILE_FORMAT = [SynapseParquetFormat]
	)
GO


SELECT TOP 100 * FROM dbo.new_ext_customer
GO
